CURRENT SCENE:
他的妈妈不是不喜欢他们的城市，而是想孟子有很好的教育。他们搬家到有很多学校的城市。他们从早到晚走路，孟子一直抱怨。

ITEMS:

[I41] 而是想【^】孟子有很好的教育   correction: ∅ → 让   strength: error
  checker's note: 想 needs 让 before a person who is to do something
  rule card (collocation_selection, Vocabulary): Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <word/expression> does not normally collocate with <noun/action/situation>; use <correct> instead.  Her terms: Time + 期间, V.得很厉害, 着durative, no了for habit/routine
  her past correction: 教育做完以后[+，]孟子考虑
  her past correction: [教育做完→学完]以后孟子考虑
  her past correction: 孟母一直想[+让]她的孩子受到良好的教育 — her note: 想 + V., cannot be followed by N.

[I42] 而是想孟子【有】很好的教育   correction: 有 → 接受   strength: error
  checker's note: one normally 接受 good education
  rule card (laoshi_negative_repetition, Vocabulary): 老是 means “always” and is used for something negative or to complain; for a neutral or positive repeated action, use 一直 or 常常 instead.  Pattern: <老是 + action> → <一直/常常 + action>: the action is neutral or positive, not something negative to complain about, so do not use 老是.  Her terms: 老是
  her past correction: 所以孟子[老是→一直]在学习 — her note: “老是“ for something negative, used to complain
  her past correction: 教育做完以后[+，]孟子考虑
  her past correction: [教育做完→学完]以后孟子考虑

[I43] 他们搬【家】到有很多学校的城市   correction: 家 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 他们搬到[+了]城市 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: [-他们]搬家每次学到了比较多
  her past correction: 他们搬家每次学到了[比较多→很多知识]

[I44] 他们搬家到【^】有很多学校的城市   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: suggestion
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 他们搬到[+了]城市 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: [-他们]搬家每次学到了比较多
  her past correction: 他们搬家每次学到了[比较多→很多知识]

[I45] 【他难怪】抱怨   correction: 他难怪 → 难怪他   strength: suggestion
  checker's note: 难怪 normally comes before the subject it explains
  rule card (perception_look_see, Vocabulary): 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the person actually sees/catches sight of <thing or situation>, so use 看到, not 看.  Her terms: 看look vs.看到see, no了, 看look, 看到see
  her past correction: 他[看得很麻烦的事情→看到很麻烦的情况]
  her past correction: 因为他这么[无→无聊] — her note: 无聊？add所以
  her past correction: ⟦害得他不高兴⟧ — her note: 害得 + harmful result, “不高兴” is not that “harmful”

items.explanation: 想 cannot be followed directly by a person and a noun here. Use 想让 + person + verb: 想让孟子接受很好的教育.
We normally say 接受很好的教育, not 有很好的教育. Use 接受 for receiving an education.
It would be more natural to say 搬到有很多学校的城市. Here 搬到 already expresses moving to the city.
It would be more natural to add 了 because the move is completed in the story: 搬到了. This is 了completed.
It would be more natural to put 难怪 before the subject: 难怪他抱怨. 难怪 introduces the reason that explains the subject's action.
